scope: Real service methods with transactional in-memory test doubles. Not a live database proof.

tests.name: Inventory reconciliation recovery restores the correct source hold when reversing a loss after residual release
Inventory reconciliation recovery records direct manager approval and a physical ledger baseline even for a zero-delta count
Inventory reconciliation recovery rolls back the source reopening when compensation cannot complete
Inventory reconciliation recovery posts a nonzero count with its own movement inside the baseline, then detects later drift
Inventory reconciliation recovery reconciles physical stock below held stock through a verified source loss and fresh count
Inventory reconciliation recovery cancels a supplier return challan after release into its own source hold
Inventory reconciliation recovery starts a fresh uncounted attempt from DRAFT without reusing stale measurements
Inventory reconciliation recovery starts a fresh uncounted attempt from AWAITING_APPROVAL without reusing stale measurements
Inventory reconciliation recovery starts a fresh uncounted attempt from APPROVED without reusing stale measurements
Inventory reconciliation recovery starts a fresh uncounted attempt from REJECTED without reusing stale measurements
Inventory reconciliation recovery starts a fresh uncounted attempt from CANCELLED without reusing stale measurements
Inventory reconciliation recovery starts a fresh uncounted attempt from POSTED without reusing stale measurements
Inventory reconciliation recovery starts a fresh uncounted attempt from REVERSED without reusing stale measurements
Independent count ledger does not assert agreement without a recorded baseline
Independent count ledger preserves unknown old history while independently detecting later stock drift
Independent count ledger rejects unknown subsequent signs and missing covered history
Opening import reconciliation rejects a stock revision conflict instead of replacing a newer ledger checkpoint
Opening import reconciliation rejects a second product identity instead of attaching it to an existing batch
Opening import reconciliation does not overwrite a sale committed after the import read
Reviewed purchase recovery rejects an invalid receipt before locking the invoice for review
Reviewed purchase recovery reopens only an unchanged unposted reviewed invoice and records the actor
Ambiguous batch identity recovery retains only a physically verified existing product without converting balances
